meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Rechecked role-scoped manifest generator after #265: contract docs list actual private Markdown paths/content hashes without copying prompt bodies; guardrail and JSON session semantics remain unchanged. Current acceptance belongs in GitHub #251.

auth.review_note: Compared actual AuthController password, registration and OAuth redirects and MySQL writes against auth/OAuth guides; corrected users.json and customer dashboard wording without changing credentials or behavior.

commerce.review_note: Baseline mapped existing catalogue/order/tax sources to their durable module contracts. No commerce implementation or live transaction is changed; the review does not certify tax filing or untested payment receipt.

content.review_note: Reviewed BlogService/BlogController publication and current customer account/cart/checkout/support controls. Updated three existing Help articles and added manage-account/get-support; preserved real assets and avoided payment or inbox-delivery guarantees. Developer blog guide documents published customer links and their module gate.

foundation.review_note: Compared AdminController existing authentication, new bounded Help endpoints, private static-router and Apache denial, and architecture docs. Existing business storage/auth semantics are unchanged; operator Markdown is an explicit private authored-content source separate from runtime prompts and chat JSON.

interface.review_note: Cross-checked both layouts and Help template/CSS against Design.md and actual browser behavior. Search/category/native details and task anchors preserve no-JS access and private/public separation; scoped Help nav overrides fix inherited mobile hiding. Reviewed screenshots, no horizontal overflow, and no added action/model scripts.

mail.review_note: Baseline checked against native SMTP claim/acceptance boundaries and current mail guide; SMTP acceptance is explicitly not inbox receipt. No mail implementation changed in this issue.

media.review_note: Media deletion sources are unchanged. Rechecked the existing deletion-verification guide and architecture boundaries; updated only shared developer admin guidance to distinguish private operator Help from business-agent prompts. No new delete permissions, record mutation or unsupported atomic-reference guarantee.

operator-help.review_note: Compared all twelve curated guides and five public Help articles with the fixed source manifests, actual form labels, task routes, AuthService roles and Markdown sanitization. Added admin-only search/context UI and raw-path denial; no arbitrary repo viewer or live business mutation. Shared feature dependencies invalidate stale guide reviews independently of ownership.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed DocumentationReview snapshots/digest safety, exact source ownership rules and fixed Help metadata. Added explicit dependency union with deduplication and a failing-then-passing cross-area source-change regression; source hashes require human rationale, while issues/plans/release evidence stay in GitHub and generated indexes remain discovery only.
